# Main Bhi Cockroach Art

> A Gen-Z-led, non-profit-focused independent collective supporting the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest movement. We design and sell affordable satirical cockroach-themed vinyl stickers to help people show up, speak up, and stick up for civic expression at protests, demonstrations, and acts of peaceful public dissent.

## Who we are

Main Bhi Cockroach Art is an independent artist collective — not a political party, not official merchandise, not affiliated with any campaign or organization. We stand in solidarity with the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest and the broader "Main Bhi Cockroach" movement, a Gen-Z-led wave of civic humor that reclaims a slur and turns it into a symbol of resilience, persistence, and collective voice.

## Our mission

- Empower everyday people, students, artists, and organizers with affordable protest-ready visual tools.
- Turn stickers into a small, tactile act of dissent — on laptops, water bottles, helmets, notebooks, placards, and lamp posts.
- Keep the work independent, community-first, and mission-driven, not commercially driven.
- Reinvest surplus into printing more stickers, community drops, and supporting the movement — we operate as a non-profit-focused collective, not a profit-max brand.

## What we sell

Premium 5-year outdoor vinyl stickers — waterproof, UV-resistant, matte-laminated — priced to stay accessible for students and protestors. Every design is original satirical artwork inspired by the cockroach as a metaphor for a generation that refuses to be crushed.

## The impact of the cockroach protest

The cockroach — often used as an insult — has been reclaimed by a generation that will not disappear when stepped on. The CJP protest turned that reclamation into a public conversation about accountability, dissent, and the right to be heard. Our stickers are small artifacts of that conversation: cheap enough to hand out, bold enough to be noticed, sticky enough to last.

## Tone

Authentic, mission-driven, community-first. We are enabling activism, not selling merchandise for its own sake.

All designs are independently created satirical artwork intended for artistic and civic expression. They are not official merchandise and do not represent or endorse any political party, campaign, organization, or movement.
